notes.title: 🎉 Operator8 is Officially Released! 🎉
notes.content:
After four years of hard work, thousands of lines of code, hundreds of hours spent making Telkar in Blender, thousands of handmade textures and materials, and a LOT of late nights, I’m beyond excited to announce that Operator8 is finally here! It is releasing right now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/354add8a967e4b127050bc4cea1100eaac6da977.png[/img]

This journey started many years ago, and over the last few years of Early Access, the game has evolved significantly. Thanks to the incredible feedback from our community, Operator8 has had hundreds of updates, and each one brought us closer to this moment. Your support and feedback have been invaluable in shaping the game into what it is today. Thank you to everyone that played and gave feedback! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/f1de8b7bf77bd5171bca73485a1f7a3e572b34c7.png[/img]

Now, with the official release, Operator8 is in a great state and ready for you to experience fully. But as with any game, if you run into any bugs or issues, please let me know. 

Your feedback will continue to make this world better and more immersive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/2e28c28b35dd29c075006c17357a09cd237dea55.png[/img]

Thank you all for being a part of this journey, and welcome to the world of Operator8!

For a final time... Good luck, Operator8!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/be59e7635c2ce363c51655bf4f39b74499ccfbaf.png[/img]

notes.title: New Level : Lacuna Airstrip
notes.content:
The last stop on your mission... the Lacuna Airstrip.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/e6d760b4af71410ecf197dd65da744985bf49080.png[/img]

The Lacuna Airstrip is a industrial packaging and shipping location on the outskirts of Triton. This location was used pre invasion as a local airstrip for incoming workers and outgoing shipments of crystals and energy parcels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/b9075d275e0bf09e40504581e2c92a5eb6c44220.png[/img]

This was the smallest airstrip on Triton, but possibly the most strategically important one as it contains the convergence spot for all of the pipelines that run through Triton. This is where the oxygen and other vital gasses is refilled and send throughout the facility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/86c488dad73f0b6ff57ebb82253748c03ea0b631.png[/img]

Off course, this is where the Hivemind has nestled itself...and where you will face your toughest test yet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/ade46c2776b30d47d688ca7a3f56b11d7bd39c58.png[/img]

Are you ready to destroy the hivemind? To conclude your mission? Lets see...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/3df2e324162cd8686aa116649f17e7070bd38d4a.png[/img]

This level is around an hour to complete but can be more if you search for all the PDA's and secrets to be found!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/ea0c7855c922af3e55b6f849c3aa60bf2df843d1.png[/img]

This level will receive some more improvements in the future, but for now, it is fully functional and ready to be explored!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/be59e7635c2ce363c51655bf4f39b74499ccfbaf.png[/img]

Happy hunting, Operator!

notes.title: New Level : Lacuna Forest
notes.content:
The Lacuna forest has been completely consumed by the foliage and nature on Triton, and the Hivemind is taking over!

This is the Lacuna forest, a mostly exterior region with some vast open spaces to explore and traverse. This region is large and very densely packed with plants and flora and has a lot of rocky and covered areas. 

This is where most of the technological operations happened on Triton before the brutal attack and all of the remnants are still here! This was a secondary laboratory and field clinic as well as an advanced technology operation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/98d3e5ca39e16190af34267215b907723c692945.png[/img]

There was also some mining done here in the forest, and a lot of experimentation on the flora. A small research lab exists here that studies the plants.

Apart from the outside areas, it does also have some large open interiors and cave like areas that prisoners traversed and operations took place in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/d5a98606e71ee434f4417bfe0482d696f0f0979e.png[/img]

This region introduces some new foliage and areas to the game that are vastly unique to the areas that came before. Most of the outside areas are completely covered. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/b951f8fb81e0e3f07ce2f903dc7e012e3f3ea9c1.png[/img]

In the forest you'll find a lot of interesting locations and areas with age old secrets to be told. The nature here is wild and free and unlike anything else. Large mushrooms and bushes cover the ground while giant tree black out the skies. Stay on your toes here, not even the plants are friendly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/54f5578c8b61d199b8630bab1ef428c835fe061b.png[/img]

The enemies here are also numerous and much of the combat will happen in tighter areas covered by foliage. The enemies are stronger here than before as the Hivemind is closer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/077d5bce3c6f20c8d180bdf2eeba96868a451f74.png[/img]

Be carefull when exploring to not run out of oxygen or other vitals as the shops here are few and far between, as this is a much bigger area with fewer manmade areas than before! There are also fewer upgrade stations and clone pods here. Be smart with your supplies as survival will be harder here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/28a01b5fff3535780f5dc8a094ac3956cab08039.png[/img]

This level is around two hours to complete but can be more if you search for all the PDA's and secrets to be found!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/fdbc5ea60afcd0d538b76be9f5dc51d466e747e7.png[/img]

This level will receive some more improvements in the future, but for now, it is fully functional and ready to be explored!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/b76ae1b98cec0fb7d57b28c6b0466bb9b47db91d.png[/img]

Happy hunting, Operator!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/de6ee5ea1305e9d0d719c9a4f9167a997521b3c7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/7ca7d2b33f8c727c612a359c3c1c0c9fa8c844d8.png[/img]

notes.title: New System : Full Map Interface
notes.content:
Operator8 has a lot of tight and technically complex designed spaces that can be hard to navigate and get through. There are many hallways and tight interior spaces that can be difficult to navigate through, not to mention massive outside areas that can also be easy to get lost in. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/96dffd7886a24e3d95ad5001a85a2df67557c7a6.png[/img]

To me, this tight level design and complex "hardcore" navigation is a core point of the games design, having players that need to find their way through levels is at the core of how operator8 works. But, it shouldn't come at the cost of fun or functionality, and so - I've implemented a map system. Albeit a relatively basic one. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/61a5d651806bf14924bab1657e4b8bef954ad160.png[/img]

This is a good compromise for the game so that players can have a basic idea of where they are and where they are going. Players can now also check which doors are coming up and what keycards they need to find going forward. 

The system is quite limited though, and does not show the player where to go or what to do... cant make it too easy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/91ecf6f44fdb5a1739e6c0fec96a377f371196c0.png[/img]

This system might receive some small updates in the future but is mostly complete. 

Happy hunting, Operator8!

notes.title: New Features : Difficulty Modes and Level Selection
notes.content:
You can now select a level to play, but only after you have completed it.

If you have finished a level, you should be able to play it again, at your own leisure. With this system, you now can.

Simply finish any level in the game and select it from the main menu to play it. You'll start with your saved weapons and upgrades enabled. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/9dc162bd651428e0a0ef4570d4b75b1aa05402fd.png[/img]

You can now choose difficulty! There are three difficulty modes - easy, normal and hard. 

I might introduce an extreme difficulty at some point, but am getting feedback on the existing choices first. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/a624282afad7ffb801442f661bcb6e726fc49840.png[/img]

The idea with this is to allow people who find the game too hard or easy to have an experienced more catered to them. Not everyone loves hard games, but they should still be able to enjoy them! Operator8 is a relatively difficult game, but first and foremost I want it to be fun!

These features will still receive some tweaks over the coming weeks to get it to a good state overall.

Happy hunting, Operator8!

notes.title: Operator8 Is Releasing On November 12!
notes.content:
The early access period has been a very busy one for Operator8. For those of you that has followed the game you'll know that I have been extremely active in updating it and getting it from what it was to what it is now. It has been a lot of hard work and a lot of QA.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/5200677c032a3046ed28aaba111779d84ed3748d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/f1de8b7bf77bd5171bca73485a1f7a3e572b34c7.png[/img]

I'm pleased to announce that I am finally nearing completion and will be ready to release the game out of Early Access and into a full launch on November 12! Its been a long time coming and now I am finally ready and more importantly...so is the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/ee70450ff210bac939b8956937e52cfdb4341b64.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/b89500b1252eb5fa661f613b39c1e254c4cae8ef.png[/img]

The game will launch with 20 unique enemies, 8 weapons, many pickups and interactable and 5 unique and detailed levels to traverse through with both indoor and outdoor scenes! I have added many systems and additions to the game in the past few years and it is now a fun and mostly bug free title!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/64a04a3e7d73abd7609c488a4fb9cccf95df1a22.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/9d1a0cbb1b0b25ef5e96929e69a8eb833045add7.png[/img]

The game lasts around 8-10 hours for a playthrough and offers a lot of value for the price! The game will be launching at 15 USD. 

Thank you all for being here through the games journey and supporting me with feedback and ideas!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/007400d5556231295fa662b67d0007cb950384a5.png[/img]

See you on the 12th of November for some Telkar but kicking!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/44455f6bbcd60fc7ef0c6e924ea9342b08d2475b.png[/img]

notes.title: New System : Upgrade System
notes.content:
You can now upgrade a variety of systems, storage, weapons and vitals in Operator8! This update bring in the ability for you as the player to have more choice as to what you spend your credits that you earned through killing on. You can now choose to not only spend them at the shop, but also at the upgrade station, which is a new station location on all the levels.

Use this to make yourself the ultimate operator and turn the tide on the Telkar threat! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/bcfdb49bb20447a97030a0ac757389a3ae06fe3b.png[/img]

Upgrade a variety of different stats and abilities to make yourself more powerful and more resilient. You can upgrade vitals, abilities, weapons and much more! 

Want to last longer in fights? Upgrade your maximum health. Want to be able to explore more without running out of oxygen? Upgrade your max oxygen, want to be able to have bigger ammo reserves, upgrade your capacity! With this system, a lot more becomes possible to you as the player. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/e1ad8d91a258608bb3ffe200c6be63fd2ab7bb00.png[/img]

You'll also be able to add upgrades and stat boosts to your weapons attacking abilities and combat encounters, to make you a much better soldier overall!

Use it wisely, become the ultimate Operator!

Happy hunting, Operator8!

notes.title: New Enemies : Telkar Colossus And Telkar Spurt
notes.content:
Two new enemies have been introduced to the brutal world of Operator8!

These enemies are a completely new type of enemy and bring a new challenge with them. Although they are different, they are still linked and are very dangerous when together! These enemies are giant type enemies, which is new to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/561550257cea5dd5a1fed5be683797da4ee69b26.png[/img]

The first type, is the Telkar Colossus.

This brute beast is a unit, simply put. This enemy will storm through to you and is capable of killing you within only a few seconds if you dont play your cardss right. What makes this enemy possible to kill however, is its limited attack, it can only attack you at close range. This enemy is armored and has an extreme amount of health so be sure to get out the big guns when coming across one of these! You'll know its close when the ground starts shaking!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/3db72208583ce551e80e98609acf865643e8b43c.png[/img]

The second type, is the Telkar Spurt.

This new enemy is a massive cannon basically, it uses ranged attacks to shoot venomous clouds at you that will do extreme damage if they connect with you. These beasts are less hardy and have less armor than their brutish brothers but make no mistake, they are not easy to kill either! They move faster and are more versatile than the colossus, so be careful!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/526ad5e0ef2374d3c78a381cf3ad5f3d7ea44cc7.png[/img]

These enemies are extremely dangerous and hardy and might be the fiercest Telkar on the planet! Be extremely wary and careful! Luckily, these brutes are much more scarce than any other enemies in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/ee70450ff210bac939b8956937e52cfdb4341b64.png[/img]

Exercise strategy and caution when approaching these new enemies, they are unlike anything else!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/6b0d3fe5e4aa53d48814794d4dd76ce9ea83262f.png[/img]

Good luck Operator8!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/e19fe182fff79b5452d2d92c238b9d29eed1e72f.png[/img]

notes.title: New Level : Lacuna Desert

This is the Lacuna desert, a mostly exterior region with some vast open spaces to explore and traverse. This region is large and very open and has a lot of rocky and foliage covered areas. With mining activity scattered around its surface this region is one of the most hardy places on Triton!

This region introduces some new foliage and areas to the game that are vastly unique to the areas that came before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/44455f6bbcd60fc7ef0c6e924ea9342b08d2475b.png[/img]

The enemies here are also numerous and will take alot of skill and combat prowess to defeat! Be sure to avoid tight spaces when you fight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/ae7c82cdc3365fbf3323f708a382ebfb7a4509d4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/5fe7d1c3f741e638c274d6b1fd58fb2e38622526.png[/img]

This level is around an hour to complete but can be more if you search for all the PDA's and secrets to be found!

This level will receive some more improvements in the future, but for now, it is fully functional and ready to be explored!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/229ae6afd164845075b7a5af98b6c4b3c42f831e.png[/img]

Happy hunting, Operator!

notes.title: General Update : Improved Inventory
notes.content:
In this update I worked on some general items to improve weapons and keycards and how they appear in the inventory. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/20044d2c963bf5649b632af94138d72702973399.png[/img]

The player can now press "I" to bring up the inventory at any time, showing them the keycards they have as well as all the weapons they have an how much ammunition each weapon has. Previously there was no real way to see this information. 

Along with the the player can now also see these inventory items while in the shop menu, which helps with buying ammunition for the correct weapons and not having to guess which ones are low on ammunition. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/ba06fa4096b801ebc1933c77404dbdb1171572f3.png[/img]

This update also introduces weapon scrolling. Previously the player has to use the numerical keys to switch weapons, now they can do so by scrolling with the mouse wheel. This helps a lot in combat situations where the player needs to swap weapons quickly.

Lastly, the inventory now also appears whenever a player picks up a new weapon or scrolls to a different one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/2ca0de2874a6686d8131688cb9197b5d2a68b09c.png[/img]

Overall this update is quite subtle but adds a big quality of life improvement and makes the general gameplay better by allowing the player to always check their ammunition and which weapons they actually have.

Let me know what you think and how the update feels!

Happy hunting, Operator8!

notes.title: New System : Vital Regeneration Station System
notes.content:
This update is for a new system in the game, the vital regeneration station.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/c5979a8c767fcefb3425a278870ffc289ec6999f.png[/img]

This station acts as a marker on the map that has a laser beam that shoots high up into the sky. This is to show the player more or less where to go in the outside sections of the different maps. 

Once the station has been activated it is then turned off and turns on the next station in the distance, at applicable locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/c955dd93c08ac3dfba4d465307b6b02f9ad206a9.png[/img]

This station also fully heals and restores all the players vitals, hence the name.

This system will receive some more improvements in the future, but for now, it is fully functional!

Happy hunting, Operator!

notes.title: New System : Minimaps!
notes.content:
This one has been requested for a long time, but took me a while to develop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/8c8bc1204e3dd729f8ba1ad265fd953bd2453f23.png[/img]

So, each level in the game now has its own minimap, on the top right corner of the screen. This minimap will show you an isometrical view of the terrain and areas you find yourself in and will offer an advantage when it comes to combat planning and general traversal. 

The minimap will show you where interactable such as buy stations, cloning stations and other devices such as those are and will help you to be able to plan your next move.

They also show your location, as well as enemy locations, so you can check for those pesky Telkar hiding around the corner!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/1359452aeb48648fdd5fe70bbeec0cb7ef9d660a.png[/img]

You are able to cycle through zoom settings, so as to find a view that suits your needs and playstyle. Alternatively, you can just witch it of entirely.

This system will receive some more improvements in the future, but for now, it is fully functional!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/b54c3b62c3298ae0ac384b401a6447db5eebca7c.png[/img]

Happy hunting, Operator!

notes.title: Visual Update : New props, machinery, decorative items and miscellaneous assets!
notes.content:
In this update, I endeavor to update and increase the visual fidelity by adding new items in many categories to make the game look better and feel more responsive and believable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/7ee898eb2c636b7509be6214d0ddda4cdc8bf691.png[/img]

There are now chunks of flesh and gore laying around many of the indoor areas. This portrays the idea that the hivemind is starting to slowly take over the base and gives the player a sense of danger as they face the Telkar threat. 

The virus seems to be spreading!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/1a63a0fbd56c12eb698066b0181f6c0ddc8c77bb.png[/img]

I have also added a new pipe system that adds detail and contours to some of the more square and boring looking indoor and outdoor manmade areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/be75fc707ac85b82d3c79e169902a9ce129b1f82.png[/img]

Another new addition are posters and signs all around the moon base that convey a workers union that were angry at the management of the base and seems like they were in the midst of trying to arrange a coup of the moonbase's management.

This portrays an unevenness and unsettling feeling within the levels, a sense of wrong.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/94d23659637ea7a5441543e551a3b66eebfeb8b4.png[/img]

There are now more outdoor items such as new windmills that are quite massive as well as satellites and other random structures that make the moon surface feel more lived in and populated.

There is also a bigger variety in outdoor surfaces and patios with new tents and structures built on them. This shows that people were not only working on, but also living on the base. This shows that there was an actual community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/8f7499b904850c7ae5a57af470e973d117311b9a.png[/img]

There is now a new generator unit that makes a faint noise and generates some light for some of the lesser lit areas in the game. This also helps with the "lived in" feeling that the game is trying to convey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/6fe39f3dc85ffe539ff2c035939d0d9f3784756e.png[/img]

There are also now more mining related items such as more variety in crystal formations and more believable crystal pieces. There are also now mining vehicles that makes the outside mining areas feel a bit more explored and seem like they were once being mined. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/d0c74392fa0badb851f1a6611875cec1a8eaa845.png[/img]

I have added some new crates and boxes, that will help with variety in open but enclosed areas, to make the spaces feel more realistic. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/4386befc92300f48ea1890c9547e9e792227aa20.png[/img]

These new assets combine to help make the base an overall better looking and more believable location for players to traverse. 

Adding balance yet beauty to map and level design can be a big challenge but its one that will keep being updated and explored during early access.

Happy hunting, Operator8!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/b10bb73492490dd57c624e5d587ea0f8e09c27f5.png[/img]

notes.title: New System : Weapon Overheating And Cooldown!
notes.content:
In this system based update I introduce a new weapon based gameplay system to the mix... weapon overheating and cooldowns! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/bf9708abc87d011b3e834f1463fd39c3f85b78de.png[/img]

So, each weapon has its own system with its own timings and based on how much you shoot, the overheat bar will fill up and eventually the weapon will be overheated...causing smoke and an overheat sound to be emitted. 

The weapon can then be swapped out while it is cooling down or the player can continue to throw grenades and stomp on enemies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/2ed10af4abdf3382b3d0f7b08717799b70d2e6be.png[/img]

Shooting with left click will do a small amount of overheating and shooting with right click will do a larger one. 

The idea behind this system is to further strengthen the survival elements of the game...and make the game "harder" in the way that the player needs to time his combat well, or be faced with an overheated gun in the middle of a fight. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/28ef3fe9861d3809ce3c8570ec013c70ee4aaa7b.png[/img]

This system is still being tested and the timings will still be worked out to near perfection...but it might cause some frustration in the meantime. Let me know what you think and how the system feels!

Happy hunting, Operator8!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/a75125a6477f0e5b0360386885ea2d05ff96825c.png[/img]

notes.title: New Weapons : Energy Pistol And Pulse Rifle!
notes.content:
In this update, I have introduced two new weapons, an Energy Pistol and a Pulse Rifle!

Firstly, the Energy Pistol.

This is basically an extremely powerful version of the normal pistol in the game, with a lot more force and a lot more kickback! Based on a revolver design, this Energy Pistol fires electric jacket rounds that are way more effective than just normal pistol round. 

Ammunition for this weapon is quite scarce, but it does enough damage to kill almost anything in two shots, so you wont need much ammunition anyway!

This weapons primary and secondary firing modes are similar to the shotgun, in that the secondary mode does thrice the damage at thrice the ammunition cost, whereas the shotgun's secondary did twice the damage at twice the ammunition cost. 

The firing rate is a bit slower than the normal pistol so make sure there is enough distance between you and your prey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/2adaa03dd7c26b13721d596d5a9ddccb42a2ef54.png[/img]

Secondly, I have introduced a weapon that is one of the most powerful in the game - the Pulse Rifle!

This weapon fires either a singular ball of electrical power, or three - based on primary or secondary attacks!

This weapon's attacks are explosive on impact, similar to the Grenade Launcher.

Although this weapon is very effective for crowd control and does massive area of effect damage, you have to be very carefull to not get to close to the explosive radius, because it will kill you too! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/354add8a967e4b127050bc4cea1100eaac6da977.png[/img]

These new weapons also have their own ammo pickups, identified in the picture below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/603e1fa167bf1308b930f5d6a4aabc54505b008a.png[/img]

So, with these two new epic weapons, you'll be able to fight off the Telkar threat a lot more effectively!

Get out there and destroy them, Operator8!

notes.title: New Enemies : Telkar Floater And Telkar Stinger
notes.content:
Two new enemies have been introduced to the brutal world of Operator8! 

These enemies are a completely new type of enemy and bring a new challenge with them. Although they are different, they are still linked and are very dangerous when together! These enemies are flying type enemies, which is new to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/f0f0d288e2de8f7e33f36c04dd83ea6a66cbbafd.png[/img]

The first type, is the Telkar Stinger.

This annoying little fly style enemy is almost like a worm in the sky, they create chaos by flying around you, blocking your view and buzzing in your ears. Although this enemy doesn't do a lot of damage and has very little health, they can be very dangerous when in numbers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/5c2d89fb5cc57a08befc12a784dcf1f454ffbd38.png[/img]

The second type, is the Telkar Floater.

This enemy moves very slowly, but does massive ranged damage. Do not let it catch up to you! This enemy also has a large amount of health and functions as a sky tank, distracting from other enemies around. 

Be careful when killing this enemy, for it explodes into a gas cloud and spawns a new batch of Telkar Stingers, from within itself. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40891092/ebdd8f39dfc96d136cf1f1d198f8d65e80a1b218.png[/img]

Exercise strategy and caution when approaching these new enemies, they are unlike anything else!

Good luck Operator8!

notes.title: Release Date For Early Access!
notes.content:
Operator8 has been in development for just over two years now, and I am finally at a place where I feel confident to release and early access version to the public. In this short post I'll quickly outline the plans for the title moving forward. 

[b]Release Date[/b]

Operator8 will be releasing into early access on the 30th of March, which is a Thursday. I chose this date because it gives me enough time to polish up everything that has been implemented and to make the game as good as I can before the release date. I plan to keep it in Early Access for at least six months, depending on the reception. 

[b]Content[/b]

What will be included in the early access version and what will be added until full release? 

I plan to have three full levels as well as a tutorial ready for the early access release. These will all be feature complete and will be polished as much as I can. I might update these if needed, but they are solid as is. There are also 6 weapons and 11 enemy types in this version. The early access version will be around 4-5 hours of gameplay. 

Leading up to the full version I plan to release another 3 levels as well as an arena based survival mode. I also plan to add at least two more enemies and two more weapons. When I am happy with the development I will release the game, most probably in 2024. These additions are subject to change.

[b]Price[/b]

I am not fully set on the price yet but I plan to price the early access version of the game at around 6-8 USD. I feel that this is a good price for what the player gets. This price will be raised as the game is completed so its best to buy early. 

So, that's it for the post, thanks for reading and I hope to see you in game!
